title: Orbit Collapse
prompt: drum n bass, uk garage, fred again, joy orbison, skrillex
description: A heads-down dark DnB roller at 174 BPM, built around chopped amen breaks and a deep sine sub-bass that breathes through the mix. Intricate percussion layers evolve slowly through intro, two peak sections, and a stripped outro — hypnotic, continuous, Joy Orbison-adjacent. The sub-bass filter sweeps wide over long arcs while amen chops morph from a sparse chop pattern to dense ratcheted fills.
